title: Signature Text-density scoring — Webpage Content Extractor
description: Signature original — Content blocks score by words per link: high text, few links means article body. Density separates articles from nav. Ratios reveal content. This record documents a Signature-authored original method of the JAH archive toolkit, clearly labeled as Signature work rather than a public record.
demo:
# Content extraction: score blocks by text density vs link density (readability-style). import re html = """
Home About

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog near the river bank at dawn.

""".replace("\\n", "\n") blocks = re.findall(r"<(p|div|article|section)[^>]*>(.*?)", html, re.S | re.I) def clean(s): s = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", s) return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip() scored = [] for tag, inner in blocks: text = clean(inner) links = len(re.findall(r" {text[:60]}") print("\nMAIN CONTENT:", scored[0][2][:120] if scored else "none")
provenance: Signature-authored original method created for the JAH archive toolkit; clearly labeled Signature, not a public record.
